title: termal_spawn_session answers 500 "Engram authorization persistence is unknown" while the child exists and reports running — the caller cannot tell whether the prompt was delivered
outcome: termal_spawn_session answers 500 "Engram authorization persistence is unknown" while the child exists and reports running — the caller cannot tell whether the prompt was delivered
acceptance: 1. When delegation creation is durable but its first turn is withheld or parked, spawn returns the same delegation and child identifiers with firstTurn delivery state held, reason and supported actions; it does not return a bare error solely for that hold. Tests distinguish held admission from failed/unknown creation persistence and verify retry identity.

2. Status and existing delegation projections show a held current attempt as non-terminal held, with reason, held-since time and last actual activity time; queued or held work is never described as executing, and previous-attempt results cannot complete it. Tests cover initial and follow-up holds and restart.

3. A mode-all wait whose children are all terminal or held, and a mode-any wait with a terminal or held child, produces one durable parent notification. It explicitly reports attentionRequired when a child is held and includes each child's reason/actions and available sibling results. Tests cover races, restart, duplicate callbacks and parent pause; held children never count as successful or terminal reviews/evaluations.

4. Safe resumption clears the hold, reports queued/admitting until execution starts and then running, and a newly registered wait completes normally on the actual result. Unsupported resume for delivery-unknown is not offered; cancellation remains explicit. Tests cover unchanged-held re-registration without an automatic notification loop and stale follow-up results.
5. The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed input; all changed API/UI/MCP paths and reviewer/acceptance handling retain the separation between attention notification and terminal result.

completion.summary: Held delegation attempts are reported, not a spawn 500. Landed as d82f78f on master, pushed.
